slice: replyer upstream generation path consumes bounded inner-domain references
purpose: Wire the H4b inner ReadView into the replyer upstream generation path: a second metadata-only reply_context capture, bounded eligible record selection, two-stage body reads and a deterministic bounded inner-reference prompt block, without changing session reuse, zero-tool, single-request, budget/deadline, double-validation or draft-freshness invariants.

implementation.capture: local-reply issues a second purpose=reply_context metadata-only capture with innerDomains [relationship,emotion,cognition,personality] (same Worker/session/audience) in addition to the primary task/memory capture; it selects bounded eligible recordIds (per-domain <=6, kind allowlist, evidenceState=valid and bodyAvailable, excluding superseded/digested/resolved/reverted/merged/tombstoned/rejected states) and reads bodies only through view.readInnerBodies for those ids.
implementation.freshness: view.validateCapture(phase=ready) is re-run before building the prompt and again before ready/loaded, so withdrawn/degraded/tampered sources cannot return old content; a missing/unavailable domain is explicit (reason), never silent empty success.
implementation.prompt: buildInnerReference emits a deterministic, bounded block: fixed domain order relationship->emotion->cognition->personality, fixed record key order, recursively sorted payload, no timestamps/viewIds; caps 6/domain, 1024B/record, 1536B/domain, 4096B/block, 4 sources; readOnly=true, authorization=none, completionFact=false, scope=current-audience; explicit omitted counts for degraded/revoked/inactive/unreadable/overBound; the existing user delimiter and inputHash(sha256(original user text)) are unchanged and the block is placed before the existing authorized-material section.
implementation.invariants: same native Session reuse, zero tools, single main call, maxTokens/budget/deadline, ReadView + Conversation double validation and draft freshness are unchanged; no new model or embedding call; Lab capture contract has no innerDomains so the Lab path reports inner unavailable reason=lab_reply_capture and Lab behavior is unchanged.

跨受众：群聊 conversation 的模式记录不出现在 DM replyer 块/正文中。
撤回：cognition 证据撤销后，块 omitted.revoked≥1 且 prompt 不含该命题正文。

篡改/缺 authority：recordDigest 变更或 access.authority.inner 缺失 → INVALID_INNER_CAPTURE；无 capture → 四域 unavailable not_requested 且序列化稳定。
不可用域：personality 初始化损坏的 store 仍完成回复，内层块四域显式 unavailable（personality reason=INNER_DOMAIN_UNAVAILABLE），单主调用 1 次。
